Durable conversation store. One WAL-mode SQLite file per conversation UUID plus -wal/-shm. Schema dump identity is conversations.db (UUID filenames collapsed). Tables: steps (blob payloads), trajectory_meta, gen_metadata, executor_metadata, parent_references, trajectory_metadata_blob, battle_mode_infos. Schema dump: sources/<version>.sqlite-schema.sql. USAGE SOURCE, snapshot-driven (the transcript JSONL carries no token counts): trajectory_meta.cascade_id is the brain conversation UUID (session identity; one cascade per store). steps.metadata is protobuf exa.cortex_pb.CortexStepMetadata: created_at#1 (google.protobuf.Timestamp), model_usage#9 (exa.codeium_common_pb.ModelUsageStats: input_tokens#2 excludes cache reads; output_tokens#3 = thinking_output_tokens#9 + response_output_tokens#10; cache_write_tokens#4 deprecated and always 0; cache_read_tokens#5; service_tier#13 string, empty so far; model#1 and api_provider#6 enums whose names are placeholders), generator_model#11 (Model enum), retry_infos#28 (attempts; 1 on checkpoint steps, 0 on planner steps). gen_metadata.data is exa.cortex_pb.CortexStepGeneratorMetadata: step_indices#2 names the steps the generation wrote; chat_model#1 (exa.cortex_pb.ChatModelMetadata) carries usage#4 = the sum of retry_infos#17 attempts, response_model#19 = the only served-model string on disk (absent from the mock farm), model_display_name#21; model_cost#5, credit_cost#13 and consumed_credits#18 are plan credits, not USD. Steps that no generation names (CHECKPOINT summarizer calls) have usage but no model string. Field numbers and names come from the agy 1.2.9 FileDescriptorSet (sources/1.2.9.writer.json, facet protobuf); they decode every 1.1.20 fixture blob and the 2026-09-23 organic census with zero unknown fields. Payload columns (step_payload, executor_metadata, trajectory_metadata_blob) are never read.
